trust-badges.looks: A centred heading and button above a row of badge logos with captions.
trust-badges.avoid: Partner logos without captions: use Logo Carousel or Partners Showcase.

fields.heading: e.g. 'Trusted by donors'.
fields.ctaText: Optional button under the heading, with ctaLink.

fields.caption: Optional short caption under the badge, e.g. '4-Star Rating'.
fields.badgeLink: Optional link to the rating's own page.
